contract: DAC_FAST_MODE must be unset for a submission run
each train row belongs to one known fold
fold roles are disjoint and exhaustive
all planned feature sets are non-empty
identifier and label are absent from model features
planned IDs are complete and unique
every planned registry row receives explicit native-Boolean eligibility
CatBoost and XGBoost loaded; LightGBM optional availability=True
selection thresholds are finite and non-negative
outer validation never chooses its own tree count
claim_id plus fraud_probability with unique complete IDs
test rows exactly follow sample order
submission parents exist and are writable
